messages:
maria_marketing: Quick heads-up — planning to announce Optimize v1.3 next Tuesday (03/09) at 10:00 PT. Need final changelog bullets, canonical docs URLs, and canary timing so we can lock the blog post, newsletter, and webinar invite.

noah_eng: 👍 working on the changelog now. Will drop the final bullets by EOD tomorrow. Are we doing staged rollout or a single-wave?

maria_marketing: Staged would be ideal: 5% canary for the first 2 hours, then 25% next 4 hours, full at +24h. Helps ensure webinar demos don't see surprises. Speak up if that conflicts with SRE plans.

noah_eng: Staged sounds fine. We'll add an automatic fallback to a smaller-context model variant in the routing policy in case of perf regressions.

priya_docs: I can prep the release page and a short how-to for the quantization profile. Need the exact changelog sentences and the rollout YAML snippet to paste into the notes.

noah_eng: Draft changelog (WIP):
- Improved batching heuristics to reduce tail latency for short prompts
- Fixed prefix KV cache invalidation in multi-tenant pools
- Added q4_legacy quantization profile: ~20% memory reduction with minimal quality impact
- Canary routing with automatic fallback to compact model variant

maria_marketing: Great starting point. Priya — can you alias the doc links as /docs/release/optimize-1-3 and /docs/guides/quantization so marketing can link to stable URLs?

priya_docs: Yep. I'll create both pages. ETA: tomorrow 12:00 PT. I'll include an anonymized rollout YAML under a code block and a troubleshooting section (health checks, rollback thresholds).

sam_product: Add a short note explaining q4_legacy: recommended for low-latency chat and high-concurrency workloads. Mention expected small quality delta and suggested eval prompts to validate.

lena_design: I'll make a hero image and social tiles. Any copy constraints? Avoid absolute latency numbers.

maria_marketing: Right — avoid hard latency claims. We can say "reduces memory footprint ~20% and reduces tail spikes in real-world chat workloads" and reference internal benchmarks (15–25% fewer tail spikes).

noah_eng: Deployment plan: canary starts 10:00 PT. Health checks evaluate 95th pct latency and error rate in 15m windows. Auto-rollback if 95th increases >15% or error rate >0.5%. release-bot will post stage updates to #release-war-room.

release-bot: Scheduled canary: 1769601111 (10:00 PT). Will post pings at each stage.

priya_docs: Quick question on the YAML: do we want to show autoscale settings? Some values are customer-specific.

sam_product: Keep that section anonymized. Show the pattern without internal capacity numbers.

maria_marketing: Timeline recap: tomorrow EOD — final changelog from eng. Tomorrow noon — docs live. Monday AM — design assets ready. Tuesday 10:00 PT — announce + canary. Wednesday — webinar invite goes to opt-ins with demo link and registration.

noah_eng: Confirmed. I'll post the final changelog with a timestamp when finished.

priya_docs: Will drop doc URLs here when live.

lena_design: I'll upload assets to the marketing drive and post links Monday AM.

maria_marketing: Thanks everyone. If anyone hits a blocker, flag here ASAP. :thumbsup: \/ quick Q: do we want a short appendix in the blog with rollback thresholds and how customers can opt out?

noah_eng: Good call. I'll add rollback thresholds and a short opt-out note for customers who use pinned model versions.

release-bot: Reminder scheduled: 1769601450 — pre-launch checklist ping to this channel.
